one-piece-start-as-celestial-dragon-and-:
Traveling through the world of pirates, he also became a noble Celestial Dragons.
Lakeman just wanted to enjoy a luxurious life.
Unexpectedly, as soon as he attended an auction, he met the three Boa sisters who had just been captured, and the binding system was awakened at the same time.
If you bind a genius, you can get the other person's daily practice feedback.
【You have bound Boa Hancock.】
【You have bound Borsalino.】
[You have bound One Piece’s deputy, Silvers Rayleigh.】
【You have bound Doflamingo.】
“Originally, I just wanted to recruit talents from all over the world, but why are there more and more beautiful girls?” Lakeman looked at the group of beauties beside him and fell into deep thought.
parallel-world-manga-artist:
In a parallel world, the anime industry is blooming. The internet is surging, a new generation of teenagers is rising, and competition among creators has never been fiercer, or more promising.
Rei Kirishima, who awakens with memories from his past life, debuts as a high-school manga artist. One masterpiece after another, he brings readers joy, emotion, and stories that etch themselves into their hearts, eventually becoming a legend in the animation world.
“A legend? A myth? His throne was forged by carving into our hearts, by freezing and reforging the tears we shed! Rei, you torment us!” cried readers, their voices trembling with emotion.
His most acclaimed works include 5 Centimeters per Second and Even If This Love Disappears From the World Tonight.
....
This is a translation of a chinese FF named: Starting from a Cartoonist to Create Anime Myths
riftans-pov-under-the-oak-tree-side-stor:
The daughter of a duke, the stuttering Maximilian, married a knight of lowly status at her father’s coercion.
After their first night, her husband departed for an expedition without another word.
He comes back three years later, this time as a famous knight in the whole continent.
How would Maximilian face him on his return?
runemaster-in-the-last-days:
Coming back from the magic world, Riya rebuked her shameless stepmother.
She was back to her first life with the world treasure and thought that her life would be smooth sailing.
But…
What was happening with the environment?
Why did the mana suddenly recover on this Green Planet?
And why did those magic beasts also appear?
Riya: ???
Ah, Riya silently swore to secretly become stronger to deal with these magic beasts that went on rampage. She would use her runes to make a better life while watching the world recover from the destruction.
Unfortunately, things were not so simple.
Her best friend’s brother suddenly locked his attention on her.
“Ah, ah, ah, you don't have to mind me….”
“The runes you make are really interesting. Can you show me more?” The man smiled and stepped closer.
“I…I can, but can you please not come too close?!”
Riya just wanted to meditate silently, so how did she suddenly attract this big boss’s attention?
script-matters-devouring-the-world-act-b:
What does it mean to dream? What if your wish became your reality?
Dan Woo is a scriptwriter who is tired of writing the same old stories, so he dares to make a wish only for his world to turn upside down. Now, he finds himself in a world of his own making, one filled with horrors, anomalies, and Ascendants.
In this treacherous world of horror and mysteries, his only ability is a system that forces him to be an actor. Join him as he navigates this dangerous reality, slowly devouring every character he can and reaping the rewards for it.
seeking-fortune-and-avoiding-evil-in-the:
Upon waking up, Jiang Fan became a low-level fisherman in Tonghe County, with a home empty as four walls and a stomach rumbling with hunger. Inside, he has a beautiful wife to support, and outside, he faces oppression from the Dragon King Gang and the Government, beset by internal troubles and external woes, nearly at the end of his rope.
Fortunately, he awakens his Life Chart with the Great Blessings Equal to Heaven attribute: surviving great ordeals will certainly bring future happiness.
As long as he gets through the tribulations, he will surely gain opportunities, with Destiny upon him.
……
Millions and millions of years later, Jiang Fan looks at the pieces of Immortal Family's supreme treasures in his home, along with the Sect's Fairies, the Dynasty's Goddesses, unparalleled demon queens, and peerless fox girls about to break into a fight, he wants to cry without tears.
Heavens, please don't send more, really don't send more, at this rate, the house is about to catch fire, truly can't withstand any more.
sss-ranked-dragon-king-my-innate-ability:
In a single day, a global calamity wipes out humanity, leaving their souls adrift in an endless void.
An enigmatic entity, responsible for the catastrophe, offers a twisted mercy: reincarnation into a deadly
“King's Game.”
Every soul from Earth must choose a character card to determine their new form and fate.
Chaos erupts as billions scramble for power. Some snatch weak cards in haste, while others luck into formidable ones.
Su Ping, caught in the frenzy, watches desirable roles like Goblin King, Blood Goblin King, and even Succubus King vanish.
Desperate, he claims the only card left: Dark Dragon King.
To his shock, this “lowly” dragon bloodline ranks among the top 1000 strongest. As Su Ping finds himself in a treacherous cosmo's where every player is a king vying for supremacy, he wonders:
If a dragon is this low, what monstrous powers lie at the top?
submitting-to-my-ex-uncle:
After being humiliated and betrayed by the man she thought she'd marry, Celeste doesn't cry. She made a plot, and her target becomes the only person her ex warned her about.
His elusive, dangerously magnetic uncle, Dominic Cross. He's a billionaire, a rumoured crime boss, and the kind of man who doesn't fall in love. However, Dominic doesn't play by anyone's rules, especially not hers.
What started as a game of seduction quickly spirals into something neither of them can control.
Secrets are exposed, and lines turned blur. Revenge turned into something far more dangerous: DESIRE.
the-100000th-try:
A Time Loop Thriller Without Time Travel. No Superpowers. Just Mastery.
Eron Vale wakes up at 7:00 AM every single day—the same day. For the world, time moves forward. For him, it's been over 100,000 loops of the exact same 24 hours.
No powers. No resets for the world. Only him.
He’s died. He’s starved. He’s gone insane—and come back sharper each time. But now, after centuries of learning every face, flaw, and secret in the city, he’s done watching.
Eron begins executing his final plan: to infiltrate and take control of the most powerful secret organization in the world—Helix—using nothing but perfect timing, manipulation, and skill.
Every conversation is a test he’s passed thousands of times. Every ally is a pawn he’s moved before. Every threat? Already defeated in another try.
But this time, it has to be perfect.
Because he’s done reliving this day.
And for the first time in 100,000 tries…
He’s making his move.
the-chubby-rich-daughters-counterattack:
She choked to death after drinking a mouthful of cold water. Was there anything more unlucky than this?
Of course, there was! When she reopened her eyes, she found herself transmigrated into a three-hundred-pound fatty.
Not only was she fat and round, but she also had a palm-sized black spot on her body.
She looked down at the layers of swimming floats on her body and swore to exercise and lose weight.
She had just lifted her leg when she collapsed to the ground. This time, she was prepared to go on a diet and lose weight.
When she heard the earth-shattering rumbles from her stomach, she held herself back.
She had not eaten for three days, but she realized that she had only lost one tael.
She instantly broke down. Sensing that something was wrong, she checked and realized that she had been poisoned.
As a descendant of a family that practiced traditional Chinese medicine, this was a small matter.
With acupuncture techniques in her hands, why would she be afraid of a little poison?
Before she could succeed in losing weight, the scumbag canceled their engagement and her stepsister came to provoke her.
‘It’s fine. Staying calm is more important.…
the-damned-demon:
Died a Hero, Reborn as a Demon...
The strongest Hero in the world killed the Demon King, the most powerful demon ever to appear on Earth. He achieved something which no other hero could ever do.
But alas, the Hero never expected his own girlfriend, his own friends, and the organization he trusted to suddenly turn against him and try to kill him.
It was the cruelest blow he was ever dealt in his life.
He still didn’t give up and tried to stand his ground, but they had come prepared, and he was caught unawares in their trap. He fought to his death only to find himself transmigrated into a demon’s body!
But who would have thought that he would be the husband of the Demon Queen!
However, life as the royal consort was not easy at all. So read to find out how he is going to overcome those trying to step on him and finally get his revenge.
the-first-immortal-of-destiny:
Shen Mo has transmigrated to a cultivation world. After learning the memory fragments of the original body owner, he finds that cultivation in this word has already been hard enough without being held back by his poor talent. Just as Shen decides to give up cultivation, he awakes the Destiny System:
[Destinied Lord: Shen Mo]
[Talent: Mediocre Talent]
[You spent 1 Destiny Point, tried to enhance your Talent, and succeeded.]
[Talent: High]
the-greatest-showman:
Is he a genius in the spotlight, or is he a madman behind the scenes of the Second Avenue?
—-
After getting the final relief from his past sufferings, Chu Jiashu was given a second chance when he found himself in the body of an infant from an aristocratic family of Hall. Now, nothing is going to stop him from achieving his long-cherished dream of acting. Enter Renly Hall, a Hollywood miracle of 21st century.
the-mafia-kings-bride-is-an-impostor:
**MATURE CONTENT**
Yvette Swan grew up believing she was the cherished daughter of the powerful Swan family.
Until the real heiress returned.
Overnight, love turned into indifference… then cruelty.
The home she once clung to became a gilded cage where she was nothing more than a tolerated mistake.
Still, one person stood by her side.
Her older brother, Nathan.
Until the night she woke up beside his corpse.
Framed for his murder with the very dagger her father once gifted her, Yvette is dragged into the Swan family’s private hell.
Her nails are ripped out one by one.
Her fiancé betrays her without hesitation.
And the family she once loved watches… as if she were already dead.
Branded a murderer. Broken. Abandoned.
Her last thought is a vow…
If she ever gets another chance… she will make them all pay.
But fate doesn’t grant mercy.
It offers something far more dangerous.
~~~~~~
Rescued from the brink of death, Yvette awakens in the mansion of the powerful Quinn family.
Their missing daughter, Isabelle Quinn, has vanished without a trace.
And Yvette looks exactly like her.
Given a new identity, a new life, and a role she can never escape, Yvette steps into Isabelle’s world.…
to-achieve-immortality-i-cultivate-using:
Traversing the Nine Provinces in the Immortal Cultivation World, Lu Yuan possessed the Dao Fruit of longevity, an eternal lifespan. If he were careful, he could anticipate the Immortal Method.
This was indeed a beautiful thing.
However, he was born during the Age of Dharma Decline, with spiritual energy depleted and the Immortal Method difficult. The great path was elusive.
Even worse, the Immortal Cultivation World of the Nine Provinces was on the verge of collapse, and the four poles were about to fall, marking the end of an era.
If that was the case, why shouldn’t a man take up his sword and conquer fifty states across the mountains?
To survive in the Age of Dharma Decline, Lu Yuan cultivated the ancient Way of Control Pneuma, established an Immortal Dynasty, and gathered Qi Luck. He brought order to the Nine Provinces and peace to the four seas.
Gathering strength from across the world, he ascended to immortality step by step.
In ancient times, there were three Human Emperors: Hua Guang, Xia Xi, and Hao Tian.
Who is the Human Emperor now?
It is Emperor Chu Luyuan.
tower-of-heaven:
The Tower of Heaven.
An ancient, towering enigma said to grant any wish, unveil any secret, and provide anyone who enters its floors a path to Godhood; it stands as a beacon of both hope and despair.
For untold centuries, its immense power has drawn countless seekers, yet none have ever emerged from its depths.
This Tower is engraved in the world’s myths as the meeting place of mortals and Gods, a realm where anything was possible. It is a monument to mystery and the pursuit of glory.
However, for one man, it represents the last chance for redemption and the key to unraveling his tumultuous past.
The Heavenly Emperor, a great ruler from an era long forgotten. was betrayed by those he trusted and died with a heart full of regret and a thirst for vengeance.
Only, the end of his life was not the end of his story. Reborn into a new world, he finds himself drawn to the Tower of Heaven, driven by the desire to understand his reincarnation and to reclaim his lost honor.
The path ahead is filled with unforeseen twists and hidden depths. Unbeknownst to him, his destiny is interwoven with forces and secrets far beyond his wildest dreams.
The advent of the former Heavenly Emperor begins here.…
transformed-into-a-penguin-my-evolution-:
Jiang Wei was an exhausted New York product tech until a black-haired woman touched him in an alley and turned him into an emperor penguin.
[Penguin Evolution System initialized.]
Now he earns Evolution Points by surviving what his human body never could. Pressure Heart. Countercurrent Sense. Abyssal routes. Rookery bonds. Every upgrade makes him stronger, stranger, and less certain that becoming human again is the right goal.
Aylin, a princess from a world being eaten by Yokai, needs Jiang to cross worlds and break their hidden soul cores. She also failed three candidates before him, and one may still be alive.
To save two worlds, Jiang must dive through haunted oceans, build a colony, survive warped history, and evolve from one furious penguin into something even gods cannot classify.
The system calls him incomplete.
The rookery calls him stranger.
Soon, entire worlds will call him Emperor.
transmigrated-genius-fragile-heiress-rei:
After years of hard study, she finally became a master's degree holder. One day, she suddenly finds herself traversing into a different world as an illegitimate daughter.
In her previous life, she was a prominent student from a prestigious university; in this life, she is a weak girl from a noble family.
She hides her brilliance, conceals her sharpness, aims for survival, and seeks peace. However, the scholarly family she is part of is also fraught with countless disputes and endless troubles.
The concubine schemes against her, her legitimate sister plots, leading to her ruin and disgrace.
Retaliation is a must!
Her attitude must be gentle!
Her methods absolutely ruthless!
She retaliates fiercely with gentle means, and what's next is...
Marriage?
To whom?
Can she choose her own spouse?
This is a serious issue.
*******************************
transmigrated-villianess-i-am-the-mistre:
I cursed the villainess.
Who wouldn't?
She was vicious, shameless, and completely insane. Vivian Astranova..a woman who faked a pregnancy to steal her own sister's fiancé the first male lead.
She secretly dated his dangerous merman cousin... the second ML, while seducing the most powerful man in the Interstellar Empire….the Alpha King himself the third ML. They are all her sister's Men.
She lied!
She destroyed lives!
And in the end, she died a miserable death.
After throwing my phone aside and swearing at the author for giving this psychopath the same name as me, I went to sleep.
Then I woke up. In a hospital bed.
As Vivian Astranova.
The villainess.
The fake pregnancy had already been announced. My sister, the perfect Female Lead hated me. The Alpha wolf wanted answers. The merman was demanding to see me. And the Alpha King had just sent me a message:
“Come to the palace. Now. I thought you said you loved me.”
I only have one goal. Survive.
I'll confess the lies, end every relationship, and run far away from the male leads before they discover the truth.
There is just one problem.
The more I try to escape them, the more obsessed they become with me.…
twin-dimension-yin-yang-mirror-attaining:
The officer Zhou Ping'an, who had recently graduated, by chance obtained a Broken Mirror that could traverse the Different World.
Since then, the sky had been the limit for the birds to soar, and the vast ocean a stage for the fish to leap…
versatile-superstar-rise-in-hollywood:
Two years ago, Aiden came to the United States to experience the American Dream. But after sleepless nights of struggle, just when he was on the verge of giving up, a translucent screen flashed in front of him - it was a System!
A System that would make him embark on a journey to Hollywood. And today, he takes his first step by mesmerising the world through his singing!
So come and join him, for his journey, has just begun.
Singing? I'm the best at it.
Acting? I have Oscars lying around in my bathroom; you can practice your acceptance with it.
Movie Direction? They call me the king of the box office.
Novel Writing? Two words: Best Seller.
From creating the highest-selling music album to becoming the world's most famous superhero - Aiden will do everything to write his own legend.
villainess-trapped-in-the-horror-game-ap:
Huo Yingsu didn’t know how she could become so unlucky.
First, she suddenly turn into a villainess of an otome game who has reached the bad ending.
To make the matter worse, she is currently imprisoned in a dungeon like prison with broken legs and locked with chains…
What’s with this hell like beginning?
Secondly, she suddenly got selected to participate in the Live Stream Horror Survival Game.
So, how did an otome game could mix with an apocalypse world novel in the first place?
Even if they’re written by the same author, it’s too outrageous!
She had to struggle to survive in various apocalypse world, especially since her world was also plunged into another kind of apocalypse.
That alone was already very difficult.
But why are these annoying heroine and various male leads were still thinking about killing her?
Damn it!
Is there any sequel of that otome game?
One that involved the apocalypse’s background or something…
She didn’t want to continue becoming the villainess!
After a while, Huo Yingsu silently looked at the barrage of the Live Stream Horror Survival Game in front of her, wondering how they were planning to trick her again.…
when-the-phone-rings:
Hong Heeju is a sign language interpreter who has become mute due to severe depression.
For three years of their arranged marriage, she and her husband never exchanged a single conversation.
One day, her life takes a harrowing turn when she’s taken hostage.
‘Don’t hang up! This isn’t a phishing call…!’
However, her husband, who was even worse than a stranger, coldly disconnected the call.
– “Call me when a body is found.”
***
You $%#£! He’s such a jerk!
Overwhelmed with anger, Heeju decides to threaten her husband anonymously.
The problem is that he was a well-known spokesperson for the Blue House.
– “Can’t you send threats on time?”
“That…”
– “Here I’m anxiously waiting for my blackmailer’s call.”
“What do you…”
– “Are you playing around with someone else besides me?”
“…?”
Wait, is this the same sociopath husband I knew?
——–
TL/N: ‘Blue House’ was the official residence and office of the President of the Republic of Korea from 1948-2022.
